data.name: Camp
data.detailed_description:
"Camp" is an impressive survival game that combines elements of horror, action and adventure. The game begins with four friends looking for adventure entering the deep and mysterious rainforest. This forest, full of natural beauty, also contains dark secrets.

As our team heads into the depths of the forest with dreams of camping, they do not know that they will encounter unexpected dangers here. Soon, they begin to be kidnapped one by one by a malicious organization. This organization catches its prey, subjects it to terrifying experiments in a secret facility and steals its organs.

The player struggles to save his kidnapped friends and get out of this terrible facility unharmed. The game offers a scenario that can progress both alone and with rescued friends. In this atmosphere where every decision and every step has great importance, players will need to use their intelligence, courage and strategy skills.

Tense moments, a gripping story and the dark side of the deep rainforest make the game "Camp" an unforgettable experience. Are you ready for an adventure full of challenging puzzles, dangerous enemies and surprises? You must do your best to save your friends and survive!
